definition: Milvus is an open-source vector database built for billions of vectors; PyMilvus is its Python client and Milvus Lite runs it in-process.
details: Created by Zilliz in 2019 and donated to the LF AI & Data Foundation.

explainer.lead: How to install Milvus, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from pymilvus import MilvusClient

client = MilvusClient("demo.db")          # Milvus Lite, a local file
client.create_collection("docs", dimension=3)
client.insert("docs", [{"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.9, 0.0], "text": "cats"}])
print(client.search("docs", data=[[0.1, 0.8, 0.1]], limit=1, output_fields=["text"]))

explainer.inAi: Scale RAG and recommendation retrieval to very large collections, with GPU indexes when needed.
